title: C: Distributed Lock (Simulated)
description: Simulate a distributed lock service using a central lock manager with acquire and release operations.

steps.title: Lock Manager
steps.description: Define a `LockManager` struct with a flag for each lock (up to 10). Write `int acquire_lock(LockManager *m, int lock_id)` that succeeds if lock is free (returns 1) or fails if already held (returns 0). Write `void release_lock(LockManager *m, int lock_id)`. Simulate 2 clients contending for the same lock.
hints: acquire: if locks[id]==0, set to 1 and return 1.
Simulate with print statements for each operation.
